GitHub - MitchellHansen/voxel-raycaster: Hardware accelerated voxel ray ...
This project is an implementation of an experimental "from scratch" volumetric rendering engine. Using OpenCL this program is able to hardware accelerate Woo's Fast Voxel Traversal Algorithm which traverses through a Sparse Voxel Octree as described by Laine et al.
